limitations: L1: A water gel compound, including the following components: (a) hydrophilic network monomer; (b) hydrophobic network monomer; (c) ampholyte; (d) cross-linking agent; (e) initiator.
L2: The hydrophilic network monomer is selected from one or more of the following: methyl methacrylate, acrylic acid, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide.
L3: The hydrophobic network monomer is selected from one or more of the following: methyl acrylate, methyl acrylate laurate, methyl acrylate isobornyl ester, styrene, ethyl silane.

L4: The ampholyte is selected from one or more of the following: 3-(2-methacryloyloxyethyl)diethylammonium propylphosphonate, 3-(tri(2-hydroxyethyl)ammonium)propyl-1-phosphonate, 3-(acrylamidopropyl)diethylammonium propylphosphonate, 1-(3-sulfopropyl)-2-ethylvinylpyridinium betaine, 2-methacryloyloxyethylphosphorylcholine, 2-[3-acrylamidopropyl]diethylammonium ethyl-2'-isopropylphosphate.
L5: The cross-linking agent is selected from one or more of the following: polyethylene glycol diacrylate, N,N-bisacrylamide, diacrylate ethylene glycol.
L6: The initiator is selected from one or more of the following: dibenzoyl peroxide, α-ketoglutaric acid, 2,2-diethoxyacetophenone.

L7: The water gel compound includes the following proportions of each component: (a) hydrophilic network monomer, 200-400 parts by weight; (b) hydrophobic network monomer, 50 parts by weight; (c) ampholyte, 50-250 parts by weight; (d) cross-linking agent, 2-20 parts by weight; (e) initiator, 0.5-5 parts by weight.

evidence_passages: CN110358006B discloses a hydrogel composition including a water-loving network monomer, a water-repelling network monomer, a zwitterionic compound, a cross-linking agent, and an initiator.

The composition includes a specific range of each component, such as 200-400 quality parts of the water-loving network monomer, 50 quality parts of the water-repelling network monomer, and 50-250 quality parts of the zwitterionic compound.
